articles.title: Zoho’s Sridhar Vembu says no pay hikes this year, warns software jobs outlook is grim
articles.description: Zoho Chief Scientist Sridhar Vembu has said the company will withhold its usual salary increases this year as AI expenses rise and server prices increase fourfold. He cited an uncertain software business outlook and geopolitical challenges, adding that Zoho had not expanded its workforce for 18 months. Vembu said the company would work to avoid mass layoffs while reinventing itself over the next three to five years. Separately, he criticised universal basic income amid concerns about AI-driven job displacement.

The pilots claim they have faced ongoing financial and operational challenges, creating a challenging work environment. Placing aluminium foil around potted plants: How this simple home trick works, its benefits and the right way to use it to help indoor plants thrive
articles.description: Using aluminium foil around potted plants can significantly improve light distribution and contribute to healthy growth. When strategically placed, the foil reflects light into shaded areas, promoting more vibrant plant development. Furthermore, this technique may serve to ward off certain pests, though it shouldn't be relied on as the sole pest control method. Regular care and direct sunlight access are still essential for optimal plant health.

articles.description: The Pentagon has certified General Dynamics Bath Iron Works to construct a second guided-missile destroyer. This decision reflects improvements in production capability to meet naval demands. However, Congress must secure funding for actual construction of the second vessel. The U.S. aims to strengthen its naval capabilities in response to China's expanding fleet. The certification marks a critical step toward enhancing the American maritime industrial base.

articles.title: An apple a day, if you can pay
articles.description: In Bengaluru, families are grappling with rising fruit prices, forcing them to reconsider their grocery lists. Younger buyers, particularly, are pivoting towards more affordable options due to persistent cost fluctuations. The surge in prices is attributed to reduced market supply and direct procurement by exporters. Farmers are also struggling with adverse weather and crop diseases, complicating the situation even further, especially with the festive season looming on the horizon.

articles.title: SBI Research recommends LTCG on equities to be scrapped; calls for DTAA clarity
articles.description: The proposal is aimed at making foreign capital flows into equities more stable and limiting the chances of abrupt withdrawals that could put pressure on the rupee. Foreign portfolio investors (FPIs) currently face a 12.5% LTCG tax on equity investments. The Union Budget 2026 retained this rate for listed shares and equity mutual funds, continuing the tax framework introduced as part of a major fiscal overhaul in 2024.

From $10T to $60T: How India is Taking Over the Global Supply Chain | Piyush Goyal
articles.description: India is opening its doors wider to the world! At The Dilli Dialogue: Policies for a Future-Ready India in New Delhi, Union Minister Piyush Goyal outlined how free trade agreements (FTAs) are expanding India's global economic opportunities. Nine FTAs covering 38 developed nations have opened access to markets representing a combined $60 trillion in GDP, compared with just $10 trillion covered by India's earlier trade agreements, according to the speaker. The strategy focuses on strengthening supply chains, boosting economic security and reducing dependence on a handful of geographies. India and its trade partners can also complement each other across sectors, from electronics and data centre equipment to textiles, footwear and food processing. With eight more trade negotiations underway, India is targeting an even bigger global opportunity. India is opening its doors wider to the world! articles.title: Rupee climbs 1% to 95.76 vs USD after RBI moves to curb dollar demand
articles.description: The rupee surged 1% to 95.76 against the dollar at Monday’s open after the RBI introduced measures to curb dollar demand and speculative activity. The steps include restrictions on derivative contract rebooking and higher hedging costs. While reduced importer demand could lower forward premiums, higher balance-sheet costs and tighter liquidity may push pricing higher, Barclays said.
